title: Deliberate Memories
subtitle: Four reachable branch lessons
text: For your first weave, make a blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones, and one Neurotic Enzyme. A Hermitage Remnant holds a stained stone; you can also make each one from Venous Stone, a Sanguine Formation, and redstone. Crafting all four stones takes four more formations. Chicken blood may spin into Neurotic or Vivacious Enzyme. Bring the blank and archive materials to the Mnemonist. The Woven Vessel reward supplies the Bleeding Bulb and Vivacious Enzymes for Blood Shot. At the Somatic Loom, choose that recipe, project 50 mL of blood, and draw every scattered memory-orb home with the Living Staff.
